items.generated_zh: 路旁的种子和石头地上的种子
items.generated_en: Seeds by the roadside and seeds on the stony ground.

items.generated_zh: 听见了，使他们不信、不得救。
items.generated_en: They heard it, but it made them unbelieving and unable to be saved.

items.generated_zh: 那些听见时欢喜接受的话，却没有根基。但试炼时就跌倒了。
items.generated_en: Those words that are joyfully accepted when heard have no foundation. But when tested, they fall.

items.generated_zh: 听了，却被生活的忧虑、财富和享乐挤住，不能成熟的人。
items.generated_en: They listen, but are squeezed by the worries of life, wealth, and pleasure, unable to mature.
items.expected: Hear word, choked by life's cares.

items.generated_zh: 听 至高者 话并遵行的人。
items.generated_en: Those who listen to the Most High and follow His words.

items.generated_zh: 她拉着女孩的手说：“孩子，”
items.generated_en: She held the girl's hand and said, "Child,"
